meta.title: Kandatsu Snow Resort
meta.description: ~7 min by car or bus from Echigo-Yuzawa Station — 100% natural snow, late-night skiing until 2 a.m., and Kami-no-Yu baths at the base.

transit.title:
From Echigo-Yuzawa,
7 min by car or bus.
transit.lead: ~7 minutes by free shuttle from JR Echigo-Yuzawa Station East Exit — pair with the Joetsu Shinkansen for Friday-night departures and high-turnover skiing until late. ~3 min by car from Yuzawa IC.
transit.imgAlt: Snowy Echigo-Yuzawa Station and Shinkansen — winter trip to Kandatsu Snow Resort

primary.title: 100% natural snow & late-night skiing
primary.lead: No artificial snow — 100% natural powder with late-night skiing until 2 a.m. on peak nights. Sixteen courses up to 3,500 m, a busy snow park, and ungroomed zones draw young snowboarders and park riders.
primary.imgAlt: Snowboarder in terrain park at Kandatsu Snow Resort on natural snow

secondary.title: After skiing, Kami-no-Yu
secondary.lead: Kami-no-Yu inside GROUND BASE — Yuzawa's largest bathhouse at the center house. Late hours and nap rooms extend day trips without an on-mountain hotel.

onsen.title:
Kami-no-Yu &
Yuzawa bath loop
onsen.lead: Finish at on-mountain Kami-no-Yu or extend to station-side communal baths and Ponshukan's sake bath — convenience and town walks in one snow day.
onsen.whisper: Check locker rules (e.g. suitcase restrictions) on official notices before visiting Kami-no-Yu.
onsen.imgAlt: Steam rising from outdoor bath — Kami-no-Yu at Kandatsu Snow Resort

kaminoyu.title: Kami-no-Yu (GROUND BASE)
kaminoyu.lead: 4121-1 Kandatsu, Yuzawa, Niigata. Yuzawa's largest bathhouse — late hours and nap rooms for immediate post-ski recovery. TEL 025-788-0111 (resort main line — verify).
kaminoyu.imgAlt: Kami-no-Yu outdoor bath inside Kandatsu center house

egami.title: Egami communal bath
egami.lead: 1-1-8 Yuzawa, Yuzawa Town. Walkable from Echigo-Yuzawa Station — day bath ~¥600 (verify). TEL 025-784-2727. https://egamionsen.com/
egami.imgAlt: Egami communal bath near Echigo-Yuzawa Station

komako.title: Shimoyuzawa Komako-no-Yu
komako.lead: 148 Yuzawa, Yuzawa Town. Lower Yuzawa communal bath — day bath ~¥850 (verify). TEL 025-785-7660.

nearbyOnsen.pairingLead: Morning: shuttle from station → afternoon: Castor park laps → evening: Kami-no-Yu → night: Ponshukan sake → late: long-night skiing again.

nakano.title: Nakano-ya Yuzawa Honten
nakano.lead: 2-1-5 Yuzawa, Yuzawa Town. Classic Yuzawa hegi soba for lunch or light meals. TEL 025-784-3720. http://www.umaisoba.com/ Budget ~¥1,000–2,000.
nakano.imgAlt: Hegi soba at Nakano-ya Yuzawa main shop

kamakura.title: Yuzawa Kamakura
kamakura.lead: 2440-10 Yuzawa, Yuzawa Town. Uonuma rice and Niigata wagyu izakaya — lunch ~¥2,000, dinner ~¥5,000. TEL 025-788-1077. https://www.sep-i.co.jp/yuzawa/

nearbyFood.pairingLead: Morning: shuttle from station → midday powder → Kami-no-Yu soak → Nakano-ya soba → Kamakura dinner → Ponshukan sake tasting.

night.title: Late-night skiing until 2 a.m.
night.body: Ski until 2 a.m. on peak nights — the signature high-turnover experience for Friday departures from Tokyo with nap breaks. Pre-night grooming is a fan favorite (verify on official sources).

yuzawa.title: ~7 min by car or bus from Echigo-Yuzawa
yuzawa.body: ~7 min by free shuttle from JR Echigo-Yuzawa Station East Exit — pair with Joetsu Shinkansen. Rent at the station to loop Naeba, GALA Yuzawa, and other Minamiuonuma resorts.

onsen.title: Kami-no-Yu & GROUND BASE
onsen.body: Kami-no-Yu inside the center house is Yuzawa's largest bath complex — late hours and nap rooms offset the lack of slope-side lodging. Cashless options including Alipay are available (verify).
